## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint test` and `make cross` pass
- [ ] `make e2e` passes (needs rootless Podman) or the relevant suite is described above
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`) when behavior changes
- [ ] A change that loosens a protection (policy, masks, git guards, hardening) says so and is explained in the security model
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
